dimensions.energy: Visible dynamic effort, force, momentum, acceleration, and off-balance vitality. 0 is fully restful; 50 is clearly active but controlled; 100 is explosive or maximally vigorous.
dimensions.circles_curves: Size and prominence of circular pathways, arcs, and curved body or diagram lines. 0 is entirely compact/linear; 50 has medium curves; 100 is dominated by expansive full-body circles.
dimensions.axis_points: Visible limb-to-limb or limb-to-body contacts that create pivots or balance points. 0 has no contact; 50 has multiple clear contacts; 100 is extensively interlocked or contact-dense.
dimensions.synchronous_limbs: Bilateral symmetry and coordinated matching of limbs. 0 is maximally asymmetric; 50 has partial mirroring; 100 is near-perfect bilateral symmetry.
dimensions.external_body_spaces: Amount and size of negative space opened around and between the body and limbs. 0 is closed/compact; 50 has several moderate openings; 100 creates expansive external geometry.
dimensions.shifting_relations: Strength of a dominant body part, directional action, or focal emphasis. 0 distributes attention evenly; 50 has a moderate focal limb; 100 has one singular, extreme focal action.
dimensions.jumping: Visible airborne quality. 0 has stable grounded feet; 40 has one clearly lifted foot; 80 has both feet visibly airborne; 100 is a high or forceful jump.
dimensions.emotion: Visible facial and whole-body emotional expressivity. 0 is neutral or unreadable; 50 communicates clear expressive intent; 100 is extremely dramatic.

interpretation_note: Scores are image-based observational annotations of a still pose and its overlaid diagram, not measurements of an entire movement phrase or performer intent.
